output.rationale: The requirement specifies connection to approved schematic and connection drawings for metal-clad switchgear. Among the candidates, 'CROWN-ARMV' is an engineered-to-order (ETO) product specifically designed as arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear, which aligns with the specification for the Syracuse Airport. This product is suitable for the requirement as it directly pertains to the type of equipment described.
